Pre-filled reply text and fired rapid duplicate click events on Post Reply button via browser_evaluate: (1) 3 sequential .click() calls -> 3 "Reply posted!" toasts appeared, but Replies count only increased 0→1 with a single reply entry created. (2) 2 back-to-back synchronous dispatchEvent(MouseEvent) clicks (no await between them) -> 2 toasts appeared, but Replies count only increased 1→2 with exactly one new reply entry. In both tests no duplicate reply content was ever actually persisted despite multiple click/submit events, confirming the app prevents duplicate submission of the same content at the data layer. Note: minor cosmetic anomaly where the success toast fires once per click event even when the underlying submission was a no-op, but this does not constitute duplicate data being created.
